name: fix-credential-path-boundary
title: P1热修:凭据边界(API key跨域+workspace路径逃逸)
description: 两项P1安全热修合并。(A)API key跨域(check-remote CONFIRMED):zotero.rs:66-70 http_request()对任意URL加zotero-api-key;upload_attachment()(zotero.rs:371-429,400-406)把外部授权upload_url传入->key泄漏给S3等外部主机。修复:拆分zotero_request()/external_upload_request();上传用无认证builder;强制HTTPS;双server回归测试断言upload server无key。(B)workspace路径逃逸(check-localfs CONFIRMED):ensure_workspace_name()仅create()调用;path_for/load/delete/save/WorkspaceRagStore::open零校验(workspace.rs:44-46,106-128,970-983;workspace_rag.rs:29-37);CLI层9入口(commands/workspace.rs)全无兜底,../../x与盘符绝对路径可逃逸root。修复:引入validated WorkspaceName newtype全入口parse;拒绝absolute/separator/../Windows prefix;做parent containment+canonicalize。
creator: lyh
